summary_1line: Gandhari urges Duryodhana to make peace and master his passions, but he rejects her counsel and plots with allies to capture Krishna.

image_candidates.scene_text: Blindfolded Gandhari stands before Duryodhana in the royal hall, raising her hand in warning as courtiers listen in tense silence.
Duryodhana, Karna, Shakuni, and Dussasana huddle in a shadowed chamber, conspiring to seize Krishna.
Satyaki quietly slips out of the court after perceiving the plot, signaling Kritavarman to arm the waiting troops at the palace gate.
